description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is the publisher/CrossRef "Check for updates" badge: a graphic consisting of a circular ring drawn as two arcs — blue over the upper-right and yellow over the lower-left — enclosing a red bookmark/ribbon shape, with the two-line text "Check for updates" printed beneath it in dark grey. The badge sits on a pale grey/white background with a faint rounded-rectangle outline visible at the top-left corner, consistent with a cropped screenshot from a journal web page or PDF margin. There are no axes, no axis labels or units, no scale bar, no legend, no data points, no colour scale and no sample or condition labels; therefore no numeric value can be read from it. This image carries no information about the Fe-Al based ferritic low-density steels of the paper and supports no microstructural, diffraction, spectroscopic or mechanical claim. It is recorded here as a non-scientific placeholder. The badge text and colours are fully legible at the supplied resolution; nothing is blurred or cropped away except the surrounding page.

observations.observation: The image is the publisher/CrossRef "Check for updates" badge, not a scientific figure panel.
The badge is drawn as a circular ring made of two arcs: blue over the upper-right portion and yellow over the lower-left portion.
A red bookmark/ribbon shape sits inside the circle, pointing downward.
The text "Check for updates" is printed in two lines in dark grey immediately below the badge.
The badge is set on a pale grey/white background with a faint rounded-rectangle outline at the top-left, indicating a cropped page element rather than a plotted panel.
No axes, axis labels, units, scale bar, legend, data points, colour bar, table cells or numeric values appear anywhere in the image.
No sample label, composition, phase name or processing condition is printed in the image.
The figure therefore provides no evidence about the strengthening mechanisms, microstructure or Mössbauer analysis of the Fe-Al based low-density steels discussed in the paper.
